domain_label: Sweater Finishing — Quality-Acceptance Economics & the Finished-Garment Post-Wash Gate
purpose: A method for reading the economics of the finishing quality-acceptance gate for the three-article California knitwear line (A1 cotton-blend core, A2 fine-acrylic value, A3 merino/lambswool premium): treating finishing as the SECOND line of pilling defence and the home-wash-promise gate, never the first; specifying the ~8-check finished-garment post-wash acceptance scorecard (ICI pilling post-wash on ISO 12945-1, dimensional stability/shrinkage after the same home wash, spirality, colour fastness + DeltaE, fibre composition vs label/duty, measurements, seam/linking true-vs-mock, visual workmanship) as the garment-side half of the per-lot scorecard-and-code the T5 thread-checker returns to the named supplier; closing the pilling/returns loop opened at the yarn PO (T2) and feeding T5 QC; expressing the cost-of-quality trade (finishing price is small and is NOT the binding constraint, the quality gate is) as labeled estimate bands per fibre route; and computing a finishing-efficacy formula (expected ICI uplift vs cost per route) so a recipe is never allowed to promise that finishing will fix a cheap yarn. Every cost/throughput/MOQ/grade-uplift figure is a tagged estimate; a genuinely-missing number (the per-piece Ludhiana finishing job-work rate) stays UNKNOWN and is named as a blocker, never fabricated.
assumptions: no per-vendor finishing price list or in-house metrology dataset is supplied; every cost, throughput, MOQ, temperature, time, dose, and grade-uplift figure is a labeled estimate (industry-lore or process-reasoning) with confidence, never an actual quote for a named Ludhiana finisher
the universe is the three-article line inherited from the yarn deep-dive (T2): A1 cotton-blend 12GG core, A2 fine-acrylic 7-12GG value, A3 merino/lambswool 7-12GG premium capsule

finishing is the SECOND line of pilling defence; the yarn PO (T2) set the floor with the five spinning dials and the ICI Pilling-Box >=3-4 post-wash contractual gate, and finishing cannot fully fix a high-pill yarn

the anti-pill route is fibre-route-specific (there is no universal anti-pill finish): gas-singe + cellulase bio-polish earns a real grade on cotton, chemical/silicone buys only a fraction of a grade on acrylic, and milling/boarding + a few-percent nylon upstream carries wool to ICI >=4

100% of wet/skilled/regulated finishing is outsourced as Ludhiana job-work; the brand owns only the two-PO recipe and the finished-garment post-wash acceptance gate, never a dyehouse, effluent node, singe range, enzyme bath, milling machine, or compactor

the finished-garment acceptance gate is the garment-side half of the per-lot scorecard-and-code the T5 thread-checker returns to the named supplier; it extends the T2 yarn-lot gate onto the garment, and the two POs must carry the same post-wash gate

the single highest-leverage missing number is the per-piece finishing job-work rate at a named Ludhiana finisher (UNKNOWN), which blocks the T4 bottom-up cost model; the ~$0.25-1.80/garment bands are triangulated, not measured
exclusions: the per-step finishing process chain mechanics (scour/mill/soften/press/relax sequence and machine physics) - covered by the finishing-process KB (kb1)
the yarn-PO five-spinning-dials and yarn-lot USTER/IPI acceptance - covered by the yarn specialist (T2)
the T5 thread-checker device design, sampling statistics, and AQL plan internals - covered by the quality specialist (T5)
landed-cost, duty, and unit-economics math that consumes the finishing cost band - covered by the logistics/unit-economics KB (T9)
any claim of an actual, measured per-piece finishing job-work rate, milling temperature/time, or per-route ICI grade-uplift magnitude for a named vendor or construction

competency_questions.acceptance_condition: T5_SCORECARD_LOOP states the gate is the garment-side half of the per-lot scorecard the T5 thread-checker returns to the named supplier, that pilling/shrinkage/shade are the device-verifiable subset, and that an accumulating out-of-spec code is the contractual leverage

glossary.definition: The principle that finishing is never the first defence against pilling: the yarn PO (T2) sets the floor with the five spinning dials and the ICI >=3-4 post-wash gate, and finishing adds at most a real extra grade on cotton or a fraction of a grade on acrylic; a recipe promising finishing will fix a cheap yarn is the most expensive spec lie in knitwear.

The fact that there is no universal anti-pill finish: the route is dictated by fibre chemistry, so gas-singe + cellulase bio-polish serve cotton, chemical/silicone serves acrylic, and milling/boarding + a few-percent nylon serve wool; writing one generic anti-pill spec across all three is a category error producing a no-op or damage.

What finishing genuinely owns for every article regardless of fibre: the retail hand and the home-wash dimensional experience, gated by measuring hand and shrinkage after the SAME home-wash cycle the customer will run, not in the freshly-softened showroom state.

The structural fact that the finishing recipe spans two purchase orders - singe/mercerise at the yarn supplier, scour/bio-polish/mill/soften/press/relax at the garment finisher - both of which must carry the same post-wash ICI + shrinkage gate, or a step skipped at one vendor quietly passes the test taken at the other.

The ~eight-check acceptance scorecard run on the finished garment after the same home wash where the check is wash-sensitive (pilling, shrinkage, spirality, retained strength, hand durability, milling felt limit, shade DeltaE + fastness, workmanship AQL); the garment-side half of the per-lot scorecard-and-code the T5 thread-checker returns to the named supplier.

The post-wash pilling test method for soft/whole-garment sweater knits - the pilling box, graded 1 (severe) to 5 (none) to the nearest half-grade after >=1 home wash - distinct from ISO 12945-2 Martindale which suits flatter/denser fabric; spec the method and the post-wash condition, never just the number.

The twisted side-seam defect exposed when a garment knit from an unbalanced singles-twist yarn is wetted; it is the post-wash exposure of a yarn-PO dial (balanced ply, T2), worst on singles, read at the finishing gate but not fixable by finishing.

The wool-only acceptance check that gates fulling on an area-shrink + hand limit rather than to the clock, because milling is the same physics as accidental shrink-felting deliberately stopped at a target and is irreversible if over-done - the single most destructive finishing failure.

The finding that finishing's price (~$0.25-1.80/garment estimate, ordered A3 > A1 > A2) is a small minority slice and is NOT the binding constraint; the binding constraint is the quality gate, and the per-piece Ludhiana job-work rate is an UNKNOWN that blocks the T4 bottom-up cost model.

glossary.term: finishing efficacy (expected ICI uplift vs cost)
glossary.definition: A per-route comparison of the expected post-wash ICI grade uplift a finishing route buys against its cost, used to decide whether a route earns its place; high on cotton (a real grade), fractional on acrylic (grade won at the yarn PO), craft-dependent on wool (milling/boarding), with the uplift magnitudes held low pending PPS swatch testing.

nodes.definition: Establish the governing thesis: finishing is the SECOND line of pilling defence, never the first. The yarn PO (T2) sets the floor with the five spinning dials (staple, twist, ply, fineness, blend ratio) and the contractual ICI Pilling-Box >=3-4 post-wash gate. Finishing then either delivers a real extra grade (cotton, via gas-singe + cellulase bio-polish, [ESTIMATE: process-reasoning, HIGH direction]) or only a cosmetic fraction (acrylic, where the grade was won or lost at the yarn PO). The most common and most expensive spec lie in knitwear is a recipe (or a freshly-softened showroom sample) that promises finishing will fix a cheap yarn - it feels premium once, then pills and bags out one home wash later and the returns land on us. Finishing's price is small; its quality gate is decisive.

excluded: the per-fibre route detail (its own node)

probabilistic_layer.update_signal: the yarn-PO floor or a measured finishing grade-uplift changes

pros.claim: Naming finishing as the second line stops a recipe over-relying on it to rescue a cheap yarn
pros.example: a showroom sample that feels premium after softening but pills one wash later is exposed as a yarn-floor failure, not a finishing gap

cons.claim: Demoting finishing to second line risks under-investing in the real cotton route that does earn a grade
cons.example: treating all finishing as cosmetic would skip the cellulase bio-polish that genuinely de-fuzzes A1

nodes.definition: Map the four real anti-pill routes, each attached to a specific fibre - there is no universal anti-pill finish. (1) Gas-singeing/gassing (yarn-stage) burns protruding fuzz off cotton-rich/viscose yarn, cutting pill anchors - serves A1. (2) Cellulase bio-polish (garment wet step) hydrolyses cellulosic micro-fibrils for durable de-fuzzing - serves A1/cellulosics ONLY, does nothing on acrylic or wool, and must be inactivated afterwards or it keeps eating cellulose (strength loss). (3) Chemical/silicone anti-pill bonds surface fibres - A2 acrylic primary, buys only a fraction of a grade and can stiffen the hand. (4) Low-pill fibre choice (anti-pill/high-dpf acrylic, longer staple, a few-percent nylon in soft wool) is the biggest single lever and is set in the yarn PO, NOT a finish. Writing one generic anti-pill spec across cotton/acrylic/wool is a category error. [FACT for the route identities; ESTIMATE: industry-lore for the per-fibre magnitudes]

nodes.definition: Isolate what finishing genuinely owns for EVERY article independent of the per-fibre anti-pill grade: the retail hand (how the sweater feels in the customer's hands) and the home-wash dimensional experience (whether it holds its size and hand after the customer washes it). Softening (hydrophilic silicone on A1 to keep it breathable, standard/anti-pill silicone on A2, amino-silicone on A3) delivers the expensive 3-second hand - but softener can MASK a harsh yarn, so a heavily-softened sample feels great in the showroom and harsh after one wash. The gate therefore tests hand and dimensions AFTER the same home wash the customer will run, never in the freshly-softened showroom state. This is the home-wash promise finishing makes and the gate keeps. [FACT - silicone softeners; ESTIMATE: industry-lore for the masking trap]

nodes.definition: Establish the structural fact that shapes the whole contract: the finishing recipe spans TWO purchase orders, not one. Singe and mercerise happen at the YARN supplier; the wet + mechanical steps (scour / bio-polish / mill / soften / press / relax) happen at the GARMENT knitter/finisher. Both POs must carry the SAME post-wash ICI + shrinkage gate - or a step skipped at one vendor quietly passes the test taken at the other (a bad yarn passes a garment lab dip; a skipped finish passes a yarn-lot test). The brand owns the recipe in this two-PO tech-pack (yarn PO: singe / mercerise / anti-pill grade / nylon%; finishing PO: scour / bio-polish / mill / soften / press / relax) and the acceptance gate, not the machines. [ESTIMATE: design-framing, HIGH]

nodes.definition: Define the finished-garment acceptance gate: ~eight checks run on the FINISHED garment after the same home-wash cycle (where the check is wash-sensitive), feeding the T5 scorecard-and-code returned to the named supplier. (1) Pilling post-wash - ISO 12945-1 box, A1/A2 >=3-4, A3 >=4 - the master gate. (2) Dimensional stability/shrinkage - to tech-pack within +/-3-5% after the same wash. (3) Spirality/twisted side-seam - visual + skew after wash. (4) Retained bursting/tensile strength - vs un-polished baseline, A1 mandatory after bio-polish. (5) Hand/softener durability - hand after wash, not in the showroom. (6) Felt/area-shrink milling limit - A3 mandatory. (7) Shade DeltaE + colour fastness - lot-to-lot DeltaE, wash/rub/light minima. (8) Workmanship/appearance - AQL (+ 4-point for any C&S panels). This extends T2's yarn-lot gate onto the garment: testing only the yarn lets a skipped finish fail quietly; testing only the garment lets a bad yarn pass one lab dip. [FACT for the methods; ESTIMATE: design-framing for the gate composition]

cons.claim: Eight wash-sensitive checks add lab time and cost a micro-line must justify per lot

nodes.definition: Detail the master gate check: pilling graded on the ISO 12945-1 box method (the pilling-box) for our soft/whole-garment sweater knits - NOT ISO 12945-2 (Martindale), which suits flatter/denser fabric. Run a baseline of ~2,000 revolutions, grade 1 (severe) to 5 (none) to the nearest half-grade, AFTER >=1 home wash (washing drops the grade, and the post-wash grade is what predicts returns). Retail bar A1/A2 >=3-4; premium wool A3 >=4. Spec the METHOD, not just the number - ICI >=3.5 means nothing without ISO 12945-1, post-1-wash. The per-route ICI-grade uplift on our exact constructions is UNKNOWN until PPS swatch testing; keep the directions HIGH (finishing adds some grade on cotton, a fraction on acrylic) but the magnitudes LOW. [FACT - ISO 12945-1 method; UNKNOWN for per-construction uplift]

nodes.definition: Detail the dimensional-stability check: measure the garment to the tech-pack after the SAME home-wash cycle as the pilling check, accepting within +/-3-5% (confirm per buyer). Relaxation shrinkage (stored knit stress released the first time the fabric is wetted) is common to all fibres and non-reversible, so it must be spent in the FACTORY (wet-relax / tumble / kier-relax) and then compacted (sanforise) to a residual-shrink limit and steam-set to lock it - not left to release at the customer's washing machine. The check must mirror the customer's exact wash; a tumble-dry US household may force a tighter limit than the +/-3-5% working target. The +/-3-5% band is [ESTIMATE: working target; buyer-confirmed value UNKNOWN-pending-buyer] - it is NOT yet a hard confirmed pass/fail line: for a tumble-dry US household the gate runs PROVISIONALLY at the tighter end (+/-3%), and the buyer-confirmed tolerance plus the EXACT customer wash+dry cycle must be obtained before this becomes a hard accept/reject threshold, or a +/-4% lot can pass green and still fail the real customer. This is the dimensional half of the home-wash promise and pairs with the pilling check under the same wash. [FACT - relaxation shrinkage / compacting; ESTIMATE for the +/-3-5% tolerance, UNKNOWN-pending-buyer until confirmed]

included: factory wet-relax + compact vs customer-machine release

pros.example: a compacted garment within +/-4% post-wash avoids the bag-out-and-return a non-relaxed knit produces

cons.claim: The +/-3-5% target is a working assumption a tumble-dry US buyer can tighten
cons.example: a hot-wash tumble-dry household forces +/-3% and a +/-5% lot now fails

nodes.definition: Read spirality (the twisted side-seam defect) at the gate as the balanced-ply SISTER FAULT: it is the post-wash exposure of an unbalanced singles-twist yarn-PO dial (T2 dial 2, balanced ply), not a finishing defect of its own. An under-balanced singles yarn stores torque that releases when wetted, skewing the wale and twisting the side seam - worst on singles, which fine fashion knits run for lightness. The gate reads it (visual + skew after wash, within tolerance) but cannot FIX it; the fix is upstream balanced ply in the yarn PO. This is the clearest case of the gate exposing a yarn-floor failure the finishing line cannot rescue, and it reinforces the second-line principle. [FACT - spirality from unbalanced twist; ESTIMATE: design-framing for the read-not-fix call]

included: spirality as the post-wash exposure of an unbalanced singles-twist dial

nodes.definition: Detail the A3-mandatory check: the milling (fulling) felt/area-shrink limit, gated on an area-shrink + hand target rather than to the clock. nodes.definition: Compute finishing efficacy per route as expected post-wash ICI uplift weighed against cost per route, so a recipe is neither over-specified nor asked to rescue a bad yarn. The uplift MAGNITUDES are held LOW pending PPS swatch testing while the DIRECTIONS are HIGH. This node recomputes its derived scores from its base metrics. the per-fibre route assignment dictates which checks (strength for A1, milling for A3) are mandatory in the gate
the master pilling check is the first and decisive item of the eight-check gate
the dimensional-stability check is the second item of the eight-check gate
the shrinkage check is the measurable dimensional half of the home-wash promise
the spirality check is the third item of the eight-check gate
the A1 bio-polish route forces the retained-strength cap that gates its over-removal
the retained-strength check is the A1-mandatory item of the eight-check gate
the A3 wool milling route forces the area-shrink felt limit that gates its irreversible over-felt
the milling felt-limit check is the A3-mandatory item of the eight-check gate
shade DeltaE + fastness + fibre composition are the cross-cutting colour items of the eight-check gate
the AQL workmanship + true-vs-mock-linking check is the appearance item of the eight-check gate
the cost-of-quality read weighs the gate's decisive role against finishing's small price
the missing per-piece job-work rate is the UNKNOWN at the centre of the cost-of-quality bands
the efficacy formula scores each route the map defines on expected ICI uplift
the expected-ICI-uplift input to the efficacy formula is read against the post-wash pilling grade
the cost-per-route input to the efficacy formula comes from the cost-of-quality bands
owning the two-PO recipe (not the machines) is the make side of the outsource-all-wet posture
owning the acceptance gate is the other half of the ownable sliver the outsource posture keeps
the gate is the garment-side half of the per-lot T5 scorecard-and-code
the contractual leverage of the outsource posture is exercised through the T5 supplier-coded scorecard
the post-wash pilling grade is the return-predicting grade that closes the pilling/returns loop
coding gate failures back to the named supplier is the mechanism that closes the returns loop
the per-article route/risk contrast is the comparative expression of the efficacy scores
the A3 deciding dial (milling time, irreversible) feeds the per-article contrast
the guardrail governs how the cost-of-quality bands are tagged ESTIMATE with confidence
the guardrail enforces holding the per-piece rate UNKNOWN and named-as-blocker, never fabricated
the UNKNOWN per-piece rate caps how firmly the cost bands can be stated and forbids feeding a point to T4
a high A1 efficacy can tempt over-reliance on finishing while the second-line principle limits what any finish can win
edges.resolution_rule: cap each route's claimed uplift at the second-line limit (finishing adds a grade on cotton, a fraction on acrylic, none that rescues a cheap yarn); the efficacy score never licenses finishing a bad yarn

edges.why_related: pressure to cut finishing price pulls against running the full eight-check post-wash gate on every lot
edges.resolution_rule: the quality gate dominates the finishing price; a low finishing cost never justifies skipping a post-wash check, because the gate-failure (returns) cost dwarfs the finishing line

edges.why_related: the go/no-go verdict consumes the per-route efficacy score
the verdict requires the eight-check post-wash gate be specified on both POs before a go
the per-article route/risk contrast sets the spec-effort the verdict allocates per route
the verdict must express any cost/grade rationale as a labeled estimate or named UNKNOWN under the guardrail
the review loop watches the inputs to the verdict and re-triggers it when a quote or PPS datum lands
PPS swatch ICI data sends the analysis back to harden the efficacy formula magnitudes
a live per-piece job-work quote re-bands the cost-of-quality read and unblocks T4

conflict_axes.name: finishing_uplift_vs_yarn_floor
conflict_axes.description: A high finishing efficacy (especially A1) can tempt over-reliance on finishing, while the second-line principle holds that finishing cannot rescue a cheap yarn.
conflict_axes.resolution_hint: cap each route's uplift at the second-line limit; route a grade shortfall to the yarn spec, never to more finishing

conflict_axes.name: finishing_price_vs_quality_gate
conflict_axes.description: Pressure to cut the finishing price pulls against running the full eight-check post-wash gate on every lot.
conflict_axes.resolution_hint: the quality gate dominates; the gate-failure (returns) cost dwarfs the finishing line, so price never overrides the gate

conflict_axes.name: showroom_hand_vs_postwash_truth
conflict_axes.description: A heavily-softened showroom sample reads premium while the post-wash hand and grade may be harsh and high-pill.
poles: judge after the same home wash
conflict_axes.resolution_hint: always test hand and pilling after the same home wash the customer runs; the softener masks, the wash reveals

conflict_axes.name: milling_hand_vs_irreversible_felt
conflict_axes.description: More milling buys a fuller softer warmer hand on wool but over-felts irreversibly and destroys dimensions.
conflict_axes.resolution_hint: gate milling on an area-shrink + hand limit, never the clock; milling time is short and irreversible

conflict_axes.name: bio_polish_softness_vs_retained_strength
conflict_axes.description: Bio-polish de-fuzzes A1 by removing fibre, which softens and lowers pill but costs tensile strength.
poles: push for a softer de-fuzzed hand
conflict_axes.resolution_hint: spec both the hand target and a minimum retained strength, and inactivate the enzyme; never trade past the strength floor

conflict_axes.name: garment_dye_agility_vs_measurement_fastness_risk
conflict_axes.description: Garment-dye's agility and vintage hand tempt an early move that shifts final measurements (dye-bath shrinkage) and weakens fastness.
conflict_axes.resolution_hint: launch yarn/package-dyed for consistency; reserve garment-dye for a later proven hero style; never own the dye node

conflict_axes.name: true_linking_premium_vs_mock_linking_costdown
conflict_axes.description: Mock-linking is faster and cheaper but undermines the fully-fashioned story the brand prices on.
conflict_axes.resolution_hint: detect true-vs-mock linking at the AQL gate; a mock-linked seam fails the FF quality claim it is sold under

conflict_axes.name: estimate_labeling_vs_decisiveness
conflict_axes.description: Tagging every cost/grade band ESTIMATE and the per-piece rate UNKNOWN protects honesty but can read as too hedged to act on.
conflict_axes.resolution_hint: label every figure but pair it with a confidence and a confirmation path (a live quote / PPS) so the read stays actionable without faking precision

conflict_axes.name: own_a_wet_node_vs_outsource_closure_risk
conflict_axes.description: Owning a wet/finishing node would buy process control but imports the cluster's effluent/NGT/CETP closure risk onto a 3-article line.
poles: own a wet node for control
outsource all wet, own only recipe + gate
conflict_axes.resolution_hint: outsource 100% of wet/regulated steps; the closure risk and idle capital outweigh the control a micro-line gains

edge_cases.description: A recipe promises finishing will fix a cheap, high-pill yarn
edge_cases.trigger: a freshly-softened showroom sample feels premium and the recipe leans on finishing for the grade
edge_cases.mitigation: treat the grade as a yarn-PO floor failure; re-open the yarn spec rather than pile on anti-pill finishing

edge_cases.description: The pilling grade is read on a freshly-softened sample instead of post-wash
edge_cases.trigger: ICI is graded dry before any home wash
edge_cases.mitigation: grade ISO 12945-1 to the half-grade after >=1 home wash, the grade that predicts returns

edge_cases.description: Milling is gated to the clock rather than an area-shrink limit and over-felts irreversibly
edge_cases.trigger: an A3 milling run is timed instead of stopped at a felt/area-shrink target
edge_cases.mitigation: gate milling on dimensions + area-shrink + hand, never the clock; milling is short and irreversible

edge_cases.description: A1 bio-polish is specified for hand without a retained-strength cap and thins the garment
edge_cases.trigger: a softer de-fuzzed hand is pushed with no minimum retained strength stated
edge_cases.mitigation: spec both the hand target and a minimum retained strength, and inactivate the enzyme afterwards

edge_cases.description: The two POs carry different post-wash gates so a skipped step passes at the other vendor
edge_cases.trigger: the yarn PO and the finishing PO carry mismatched ICI/shrinkage thresholds
edge_cases.mitigation: carry the same post-wash ICI + shrinkage gate on both POs so neither vendor's skipped step passes the other's test

edge_cases.description: The per-piece finishing job-work rate is fabricated to unblock the T4 cost model
edge_cases.trigger: a placeholder rate is fed as a point into a margin model without a live quote
edge_cases.mitigation: hold the rate UNKNOWN and named as the T4 blocker; refuse the triangulated band as a point

edge_cases.description: Cellulase bio-polish is specified on acrylic or wool where it does nothing
edge_cases.trigger: a generic anti-pill spec applies bio-polish across all three fibres
edge_cases.mitigation: restrict cellulase to cotton/cellulosics; route acrylic to chemical/silicone and wool to milling/nylon%

edge_cases.description: Shrinkage is measured on a different wash cycle than the pilling check
edge_cases.trigger: the dimensional check uses a gentler or different wash than the customer's
edge_cases.mitigation: measure shrinkage after the SAME home wash as the pilling check and confirm the buyer's wash/dry profile

edge_cases.description: Spirality on a singles fine-gauge knit is blamed on finishing and a finishing fix is chased
edge_cases.trigger: a twisted side-seam appears post-wash and is routed to the finisher
edge_cases.mitigation: route spirality to the yarn-PO balanced-ply clause; it is read at the gate but fixed upstream

edge_cases.description: Mock-linking is accepted as true linking and erodes the fully-fashioned premium
edge_cases.trigger: a mock-linked seam is passed at the AQL gate as fully-linked
edge_cases.mitigation: detect true loop-to-loop vs mock-linking at the gate; a mock seam fails the FF claim it is sold under

edge_cases.description: A hero-style garment-dye drop is run on fine 12GG knits before the style is proven
edge_cases.trigger: garment-dye agility is chosen for the launch instead of bought-dyed
edge_cases.mitigation: launch bought-dyed stock shades; reserve garment-dye for a later proven hero with a sample dye trial first

edge_cases.description: A blend-ratio drift (e.g. 70/30 to 60/40) is both a quiet cost-down and a duty misdeclaration
edge_cases.trigger: the fibre-composition test against the care label is skipped
edge_cases.mitigation: verify fibre composition vs the label with a tolerance (e.g. +/-3% by mass) since it sets both hand and the duty line

workflow.action: State finishing as the second line of defence
workflow.description: Anchor that the yarn PO sets the ICI floor and finishing adds at most a grade (cotton) or a fraction (acrylic), never a rescue of a cheap yarn
workflow.gate: the yarn-PO floor and the fix-a-cheap-yarn spec lie are both stated with honesty tags

workflow.action: Map the four fibre-matched anti-pill routes
workflow.description: Tie singe + bio-polish to A1, chemical/silicone to A2, milling/boarding + nylon% to A3, and flag low-pill fibre as a yarn-PO lever
workflow.gate: each route is tied to its fibre with the cellulosics-only limit of bio-polish stated

workflow.action: Split the recipe across two POs with one shared gate
workflow.description: Place singe/mercerise at the yarn supplier and scour/bio-polish/mill/soften/press/relax at the finisher, both carrying the same post-wash gate
workflow.gate: the step split is named and the same-gate-on-both-POs requirement is stated

workflow.action: Specify the eight-check post-wash acceptance gate
workflow.description: List the eight checks with method and accept threshold, run on the finished garment after the same home wash
workflow.gate: all eight checks have a method and threshold and the both-ends testing rationale is stated

workflow.action: Detail the pilling and shrinkage gates
workflow.description: Set ISO 12945-1 post-wash half-grade pilling (A1/A2 >=3-4, A3 >=4) and +/-3-5% same-wash shrinkage
workflow.gate: the box method, post-wash rule, thresholds, and same-wash shrinkage tolerance are stated

workflow.action: Detail the per-article mandatory and cross-cutting checks
workflow.description: Set the A1 retained-strength cap, the A3 milling felt limit, spirality, shade DeltaE + fastness + composition, and AQL/linking
workflow.gate: the A1 strength cap and A3 milling limit are mandatory and the cross-cutting colour/composition/workmanship checks are specified

workflow.action: Read the cost-of-quality trade and name the blocker
workflow.description: State the per-article finishing bands as estimates (A3 > A1 > A2), conclude price is not the constraint, and hold the per-piece rate UNKNOWN
workflow.gate: the bands are estimate-tagged with the ordering and the per-piece rate is UNKNOWN-and-named-as-T4-blocker

workflow.action: Compute the finishing-efficacy formula per route
workflow.description: Weigh expected ICI uplift against cost per route, returning A1 high / A2 fractional / A3 craft, directions high and magnitudes low
workflow.gate: the efficacy reasoning and the per-article read are stated with magnitudes held low pending PPS

workflow.action: Set the outsource posture and the ownable sliver
workflow.description: Outsource 100% of wet/regulated steps and own only the two-PO recipe + the acceptance gate, leverage contractual
workflow.gate: the outsource-all-wet posture and the recipe + gate sliver are stated with the four reasons

workflow.action: Wire the gate into the T5 scorecard and close the returns loop
workflow.description: Cast the gate as the garment-side half of the per-lot T5 scorecard-and-code and close the pilling/returns loop from T2
workflow.gate: the pilling/shrinkage/shade device subset is named and the same-gate-both-POs returns-loop closure is stated

workflow.description: Combine efficacy, the gate, cost, and the guardrail into an add/reject call that refuses a fix-a-cheap-yarn or clock-gated-milling recipe
workflow.gate: the verdict refuses the named no-go conditions and states price never overrides the gate

workflow.action: Set the finishing review cadence and triggers
workflow.description: Define the refresh cadence and material-change triggers routing back to the efficacy formula, the gate, and the cost read
workflow.gate: a cadence and trigger list (live job-work quote highest-leverage) routing to efficacy/gate/cost exist

priority_rationale: The second-line principle, the fibre-matched route map, the two-PO recipe, and the home-wash promise are foundational because the gate, the cost read, and the efficacy formula all read from them; the eight-check gate and its per-check details (pilling, shrinkage, spirality, retained strength, milling limit, fastness/composition, workmanship) build directly on the recipe and route map; the cost-of-quality trade and its job-work-rate blocker precede the efficacy formula they constrain; the outsource posture, the T5 scorecard loop, and the returns-loop closure govern how the gate is owned and wired; the honesty guardrail governs every cost/grade expression; and the per-route go/no-go verdict plus the review loop come last because they compose all upstream reads into a decision and a self-correcting refresh.

dominance_rules.rule: The quality gate dominates the finishing price
dominance_rules.rationale: a gate failure (pilling, bag-out, shade drift, returns) costs orders of magnitude more than the finishing line
dominance_rules.trigger: pressure to cut finishing cost by skipping a post-wash check
dominance_rules.action: run the full eight-check post-wash gate; a low finishing price never justifies skipping a check

dominance_rules.rule: The yarn-PO floor dominates any finishing grade claim
dominance_rules.rationale: finishing is the second line of defence and cannot rescue a cheap high-pill yarn
dominance_rules.trigger: a recipe leans on finishing to win a grade the yarn cannot
dominance_rules.action: route the grade shortfall to the yarn spec; refuse the recipe that promises finishing will fix a cheap yarn

dominance_rules.rule: The post-wash condition dominates the showroom state
dominance_rules.rationale: softener masks a harsh or high-pill yarn that one home wash reveals
dominance_rules.trigger: hand or pilling is judged on a freshly-softened sample
dominance_rules.action: test hand and pilling after the same home wash the customer runs

dominance_rules.rule: The area-shrink felt limit dominates the milling clock
dominance_rules.rationale: milling is short and irreversible, the single most destructive finishing failure
dominance_rules.trigger: an A3 milling run is gated to the clock
dominance_rules.action: stop milling at the dimensions + area-shrink + hand limit, never the clock

dominance_rules.rule: The retained-strength floor dominates the bio-polish hand target
dominance_rules.rationale: bio-polish de-fuzzes by removing fibre and can thin A1 into a returnable garment
dominance_rules.trigger: a softer de-fuzzed A1 hand is pushed without a strength floor
dominance_rules.action: hold the minimum retained strength and inactivate the enzyme; do not trade past the floor

dominance_rules.rule: True loop-to-loop linking dominates a mock-linking cost-down
dominance_rules.rationale: a mock-linked seam undermines the fully-fashioned story the brand prices on
dominance_rules.trigger: mock-linking is offered as a cost-down on an FF article
dominance_rules.action: require and verify true loop-to-loop linking at the AQL gate

dominance_rules.rule: The outsource-all-wet posture dominates any in-house wet-node temptation
dominance_rules.rationale: owning a wet node imports the cluster's effluent/NGT/CETP closure risk onto a 3-article line
dominance_rules.trigger: owning a singe/enzyme/milling/dye node is proposed for control
dominance_rules.action: outsource 100% of wet/regulated steps and own only the recipe + gate

dominance_rules.rule: A flagged UNKNOWN dominates a confident downstream cost conclusion built on it
dominance_rules.rationale: no bottom-up finishing cost can be more certain than the missing per-piece job-work rate it rests on
dominance_rules.trigger: the per-piece rate is fabricated to firm up a margin number
dominance_rules.action: hold the rate UNKNOWN, cap the cost conclusion's confidence, and name the live quote as the confirmation

anti_rework_rules.rule: Assign the anti-pill route per fibre before specifying any finishing step
anti_rework_rules.prevents: a generic anti-pill spec that no-ops on acrylic/wool or damages a fibre and must be re-cut per route

anti_rework_rules.rule: Carry the same post-wash gate on both POs the first time the recipe is split
anti_rework_rules.prevents: a skipped step passing at the wrong vendor and a full re-test once the mismatch is found

anti_rework_rules.rule: Gate the pilling and shrinkage checks to the SAME home wash when the gate is written
anti_rework_rules.prevents: a false showroom pass that a post-wash retest later overturns

anti_rework_rules.rule: Attach the retained-strength cap to A1 bio-polish and the area-shrink limit to A3 milling when the route is chosen
anti_rework_rules.prevents: an over-removed thin A1 or an over-felted A3 that is irreversible and must be scrapped

anti_rework_rules.rule: Tag every cost/grade band ESTIMATE and the per-piece rate UNKNOWN at the moment it is written
anti_rework_rules.prevents: a later honesty sweep that must re-caveat figures already quoted as if measured

anti_rework_rules.rule: Hold the per-piece job-work rate UNKNOWN and name it as the T4 blocker the first time cost is discussed
anti_rework_rules.prevents: T4 inheriting a fabricated point that a live quote later forces a full re-derivation of

anti_rework_rules.rule: Cast the gate as the garment-side half of the T5 scorecard when the gate is specified
anti_rework_rules.prevents: building a separate finishing-QC system that must later be merged into the T5 supplier-coded loop

anti_rework_rules.rule: Verify fibre composition against the care label with a tolerance when the blend is set
anti_rework_rules.prevents: a blend drift surfacing late as both a cost-down and a duty misdeclaration that must be reworked

iteration_protocol.trigger: a live per-piece finishing job-work quote at a named Ludhiana finisher is obtained
iteration_protocol.action: replace the placeholder cost bands with the measured rate, unblock the T4 cost model, and re-band the cost-of-quality read

iteration_protocol.trigger: PPS swatch ICI testing returns measured per-route grade uplift on our exact constructions
iteration_protocol.action: harden the efficacy formula magnitudes from directional to measured and re-read the per-article contrast

iteration_protocol.trigger: in-cluster wool-milling capacity and felt-control reliability is confirmed or characterized
iteration_protocol.action: resolve the A3 craft feasibility and re-read the milling felt limit and the per-article risk

iteration_protocol.trigger: local gas-singe + cellulase bio-polish availability/MOQ/price as job-work is confirmed
iteration_protocol.action: confirm whether A1's real anti-pill route exists in-cluster or must be designed around, and update the route map

iteration_protocol.trigger: a buyer confirms or tightens the shrinkage tolerance (e.g. for a tumble-dry household)
iteration_protocol.action: re-set the dimensional-stability accept limit and re-run the affected gate

iteration_protocol.trigger: a dye-stage change or a hero-style garment-dye trial is proposed
iteration_protocol.action: re-run the DeltaE/fastness/composition read and the measurement-shift risk before committing

iteration_protocol.trigger: the CETP/NGT enforcement status or the brand's volume scale changes
iteration_protocol.action: re-confirm the outsource-all-wet posture and the contractual leverage of the T5 scorecard
